senses.example: Vivo en una calle muy tranquila.
senses.exampleGloss: I live on a very quiet street.

alternatives.reason: Formal/administrative; neutral calle is what people say.
A wide main street; a type of calle, not a synonym.
Narrow side passage; a different street type.

notes: en la calle is the Peninsular pattern; the learner should also know the address pattern calle Mayor.
